filing.title: CVR Noise Target Inc. SC TO-T
filing.bodyText:
SC TO-T
Subject Company: CVR Noise Target Inc.
Offeror: CVR Buyer Inc.
CVR Buyer Inc. commenced a third-party tender offer. Stockholders will receive $125.00 per share in cash. Each holder of Shares will be entitled to one CVR for each Share. The CVR is not stock exchange consideration.
